name: pnp-devproxy-simulate-google-gemini
title: Simulate the Google Gemini API
shortDescription: This sample contains mock responses that allow you to simulate the Google Gemini API using Dev Proxy. Simulating the Gemini API is useful when you're working on parts of your app that don't require a real response from Gemini and don't want to incur unnecessary API costs.
longDescription: This sample contains mock responses that allow you to simulate the Google Gemini API using Dev Proxy. Simulating the Gemini API is useful when you're working on parts of your app that don't require a real response from Gemini and don't want to incur unnecessary API costs.
